results.title: Don't Trust the Couple Upstairs
results.overview: Newlyweds Maria and Joe rent out part of their house to Vicki and Clay, a friendly but enigmatic couple. Living together starts well, but when Vicki is killed, Maria uncovers secrets that make her realize Joe isn't the man she married.

results.title: Final Interview
results.overview: Six college students meet at the final interview of a global IT company. Growing closer as they prepare for the group discussion, they dare to dream that all six might make it — until the day before the interview, when the company announces its verdict: only one will be hired. On the day of the interview, mysterious envelopes arrive, each containing one of their secrets — and suspicion begins to take hold. Who among the six is the liar?

results.title: Bazaar (Murder in the Building)
results.overview: Misanthropic novelist François writes gripping crime stories – “Agatha Christie meets The Scarlet Pimpernel” – but outside of the swashbuckling imaginary world of his Marquis la Rose-novels, life is far from thrilling. His partner Colette, a professor at the Sorbonne and world-renowned expert on Alfred Hitchcock, is tired of watching François sit around their apartment in his pyjamas and yearns for the excitement of the classic films she watches with her students. When Colette begins to suspect their flamboyant actor neighbour of murdering his wife, the couple’s mundane lives are turned upside down – and their stale relationship is jolted back to life.

results.title: BTS THE COMEBACK LIVE | ARIRANG
results.overview: BTS is back. The iconic group returns to the stage for a live reunion concert to perform legendary hits and unveil brand-new tracks.

results.title: Making Marie Antoinette
results.overview: Eleanor Coppola turns her camera on her daughter, Sofia, as she shoots Marie Antoinette. Catching every detail of the behind-the-scenes and on-set action, Eleanor captures the feat of Sofia’s directing a landmark film aged 34, and muses on what it means for a mother to watch her daughter at work.

results.title: Second Season
results.overview: A few years ago, Paula Ferrara wrote “The Pussy and the Razor.” Its success turned her into “the voice of her generation.” Today, Paula is a failed writer—a ghostwriter who earns a living churning out books for mediocre influencers. Her latest, desperate assignment is to pen the biography of Lil Rogelio, a fading trap music legend fresh out of prison who is supposedly seeking redemption. But are Paula and Lil Rogelio truly prepared for this second season?

results.title: The Rope Curse 4: Kuntilanak
results.overview: When a forbidden Indonesian exorcism is broadcast live online, it unleashes a legendary demonic entity across Asia, forcing the grieving son of a Taiwanese victim to trace the curse back to its ancient, blood-soaked roots in rural Indonesia before it consumes everyone in its digital wake.

results.title: Milky☆Subway: The Galactic Limited Express - the Movie
results.original_title: 銀河特急 ミルキー☆サブウェイ 各駅停車劇場行き
results.overview: Six delinquents are tasked with cleaning a train as part of a community service program. But when the train suddenly takes off, chaos ensues.

results.title: Born in the USSR: 35 Up
results.overview: The documentary series "Born in the USSR" is a unique chronology which began in 1989 and has continued for more than 30 years. The authors follow 20 children from different Republics of the former Soviet Union revisiting their life stories every seven years. The new film focuses on the age of 35 years, the time of adulthood and re-evaluation when a man finds himself at the "midpoint" of his life. This is a series about the coming of age of a generation, the search for oneself, about the human being undergoing changes in the changing world.

results.title: Drifter
results.overview: In a forgotten desert town, a solitary racetrack janitor with a gift for drifting is haunted by his tragic past. Given a single chance to compete at a pro drifting event, he discovers his raw talent is useless without the one thing he's always avoided: connection with others. Under a hardened mentor, he must learn to trust his found family and transform his untamed, lonely art into a dangerous dance of partnership, or be consumed and controlled by the past he's desperate to escape.

results.title: The House on Haunted Grounds
results.overview: What begins as a routine investigation into a house slated for demolition turns into a nightmare when the team faces an evil force, leaving behind only the recovered footage.

results.title: The President's Cake
results.overview: While people across 1990’s Iraq struggle to survive, 9-year-old Lamia has been selected to prepare a cake to celebrate the President’s birthday. In a landscape of fear and scarcity, where basic ingredients are nearly impossible to find, Lamia sets out on a determined journey throughout the big city in search of eggs, flour, and sugar. Accompanied by her grandmother, her loyal friend Saeed, and her pet rooster Hindi, she navigates vendors and police officers along the way.

results.title: Mārama
results.overview: 1859. When a young Māori woman is summoned from New Zealand to North Yorkshire, she uncovers her horrific colonial heritage and is compelled to confront and destroy the titled Englishman who devastated her family.

results.title: Euphoria: A Look Back
results.overview: The cast and crew of HBO's Euphoria take an exclusive look back at the critically acclaimed series' origins, evolution, and influences.

results.title: Terminator: Of Machines and Men... and One Woman
results.original_title: Terminator, des machines et des hommes... et une femme

results.title: EPiC: Elvis Presley in Concert
results.overview: Long-lost footage from Elvis Presley's legendary Las Vegas residency in the 1970s woven together with rare 16mm footage from Elvis on Tour, and 8mm from the Graceland archive, plus recordings of Elvis telling "his side of the story" rediscovered during Baz Luhrmann's research for his 2022 film, Elvis.

results.title: Gentle Monster
results.overview: After relocating with her family to the countryside, a renowned pianist uncovers a life-shattering truth that forces her to confront the complexities of love, trust, and deception.

results.title: Aadarsha Kutumbam House No: 47 - AK47
results.overview: A tight-knit family faces an unexpected crisis that threatens their bond, forcing them to re-evaluate their values and fight to stay united.

results.title: Raakaasa
results.overview: Returning home after a decade, an NRI chasing romance inadvertently awakens an ancient darkness long feared by his village. As the threat intensifies, love turns deadly and life hangs in the balance.
